title: Hold Free and Fair Elections
description: Nepal completed its parliamentary election in March 2026. This public agenda is now treated as delivered, while deeper verification of candidate vetting, campaign finance transparency, and electoral integrity belongs in tracker-backed evidence.

problem.short: This electoral milestone has already been delivered. The platform should reflect that the election itself is complete rather than still describing it as an upcoming event.
problem.long: Nepal completed its parliamentary election in March 2026. That means the public platform should no longer present this agenda as a future commitment or countdown. The completed election is a delivered milestone. What remains important now is post-election accountability: whether candidate vetting standards were strong enough, whether campaign finance disclosures were meaningful, whether electoral fairness held in practice, and what reforms still remain unfinished. Those deeper questions belong in tracker-backed evidence and follow-on reform agendas, not in a still-pending election status.
